{{Quote|quote=[[The Wheel of Time (video game)|The Wheel of Time]] was praised by critics when it launched, partly due to its association with the popular series of fantasy novels, but equally due to its decent singleplayer campaign and innovative multiplayer mode. Despite this, it sold poorly, fading quickly amid the torrent of first-person shooters that rushed across shelves in the late nineties.|speakers=Rick Lane|other_refs={{ref||pcgamer}}}}
